title: SpoolSpot clip
description: A tagged label clip. It belongs to one filament for life. The tenant is implied by the caller and is never part of the document. Licensed CC0-1.0 (see REUSE.toml).

tag_id.description: 12 random characters from the Crockford base32 alphabet, uppercase. Carries no personal data.

location_id.description: Where the clip is now; null until it has been placed.

state.description: on_spool: on a spool in use or storage. spool_empty: the spool is spent. free: in clip storage, waiting for the next spool of its filament.
